name: baton
description: Catch where decisions, code, and docs disagree — a concept map pinned to commits, plus session handoff checks. 결정·코드·문서의 어긋남을 잡는 Claude Code 플러그인.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Finds where your project's decisions, code, and docs disagree, one concept at a time, and records the commit each concept was checked at so unchanged concepts are never re-read. Also lints and auto-injects session handoffs (HANDOFF.md). 결정·코드·문서의 어긋남을 개념 단위로 추적하는 플러그인.
